contracts.palette: The layer loop reserves each smooth palette before rigid draws. The bridge writes palette matrices only at the later smooth call, reads the exact forwarded pointer for mesh-local matrix selection, and materializes palettes even when every smooth handle is invalid. Existing palettes in a reused state are not rewritten. Matrix scratch is explicit, valid and disjoint; it represents the original transient stack matrix.

Only nonnull skin resolves a typed source mesh. Weights are read at native weight-pointer+8 and count at mesh+40; rigid draws do not resolve a mesh or dereference weights. The adapter verifies resolved resource identity and forwards original metadata/alpha.
